scope: Independent next research cycle, one input-only TRAIN CAD; root coordinator alone releases actual GPU execution

access.source_check: Standard-library AST, small JSON/source identities and xyz file stat only; no scientific array, Torch, model, weights or GPU
access.author_execution: source-check only; no toy or redundant scientific pre-read
access.actual_execution: One root-coordinator GPU job after source review, with no installing/cloning dependencies

construction.lattice: torch.linspace(0,1,64,float32) on actual device, x-major z-fastest; retain grid_axis/grid_xyz for exact replay
construction.bound: Conservative integer boxes widened by actual float32-lattice roundoff versus i/(R-1) and a fixed FP64 arithmetic pad; widening applies only to enumeration
construction.predicate: Float32 stored points and lattice promoted to float64; squared Euclidean distance <= float64(0.033)^2; no distance tolerance
construction.grid_queries: 262144 rows; neighbor IDs index canonical original points; sort by grid ID then point ID
construction.point_queries: 179316 rows; neighbor IDs index lattice; natural point-major enumeration, sorted grid neighbors per point
construction.same_edge_set: One full enumerated pair set, reindexed without truncation for the reverse CSR orientation
construction.empty_latent_rows: Legal and retained, report actual empty counts/fraction and row-pointer-defined full inventory
construction.point_coverage: Report actual fraction/all-covered flag; zero-neighbor point rows are not filled or dropped
construction.distance_cache: Float64 squared normalized-length distances aligned with each CSR; no mollifier/kernel weights are computed

outputs.summary: summary.json status completed + config.contract + checks/stats/costs/memory/receipt; infeasible coverage remains a completed negative result
outputs.status: status.json for the single coordinator; partial output immutable, no silent restart or budget/radius change
outputs.input_cache: Eight NPY arrays: each orientation row_ptr/int64 neighbors_index/float64 squared_distances plus float32 grid_axis/grid_xyz; inventory paths/shapes/dtypes/bytes/stat/in-memory values SHA
outputs.reuse: Completed contract and inventory stat must match; reuse has no scientific reads or CUDA execution

success_for_future_decision_only: CSR invariants passed and all point queries have neighbors; latent empties are reported but legal. Future all-CAD preparation/model decisions require separate root selection.
limitations: This is radius-neighborhood input feasibility, not GINO training or neuraloperator API acceptance. No direct CSR kwargs are passed to official GINO.
Empirical point neighborhoods are not FEM volume integration, elasticity/stiffness, boundary-role preservation, or exact geodesics.
No features or named BC roles are read, so this stage cannot claim interface-role coverage or lack of BC aliasing.
No kernel weighting or new-query cutoff probe occurs; CSR construction alone does not certify continuous-query behavior.
Measured memory/time cover this geometry enumerator/sort/cache only; no hypothetical GNO/FNO activations/backward/model memory is reported as measured.
This new research cycle must not adapt to the already-used final evaluation; no validation/final/dia arrays are opened here.
